name: ikea.PictureBanner
summary: A picture with a caption and an arrow that leads somewhere (a room, an idea, a sale), or, without a picture, a block of a brand colour with large words and a circled arrow; or a picture with its words on a colour panel beside or under it. The block and panel colours are the brand map's surfaces (band, feature). The whole banner is one link. An IKEA template part (owner Q138, Q140). Not for a product with a price (use ProductTile), or for the page's opening with actions (use Hero).
a11y: One link named by its words (and its tag, read first). The picture is decorative there, since the words say where it leads; the arrow is decorative. Words over a picture sit on a shade, so they read on any picture; words on a panel take the surface's own on-colour.

props.name: title
props.description: The words: "Find the little things that make a room". The whole banner is the link.

props.name: text
props.description: One line under the title: "On bedroom favourites".

props.name: note
props.description: A small print line at the foot of a colour block or panel: "*Terms and conditions apply".

props.name: picture
props.description: The picture; leave it out for a colour block.

props.name: caption
props.description: Where the words sit: `over` (default) white on a shade at the picture's foot; `below` under the picture; `side` in a colour panel beside the picture (a band across the page); `panel` in a colour panel under the picture.

props.name: surface
props.description: The colour of a block or caption panel, from the brand map (Q140): `band` the lead colour (blue), `feature` the second colour (yellow), `promo` the promotion colour (`color.promo.new`, an orange block over new arrivals, Q141).

props.name: titleSize
props.description: `display`: the block's title at display size, for a sale's headline ("Up to 40% off").

props.name: ratio
props.description: The picture's shape; `ultrawide` on a colour block makes a band across the page, its words and arrow in one row.

props.name: tag
props.description: A short tag at the picture's top corner: "New", "Lower price", "Member price".

props.name: tagTone
props.description: The tag's colour: `new` or `offer` (`color.promo.*`, Q139), `brand` (the band colour, a member price) or `feature` (the second colour, an in-store price). A square box of small bold words (Q141).

props.name: priority
props.description: Above the fold: load the picture first.
